info.name: Companies AI Embed Payment Methods API

items.docs: Calls the payment gateway to validate the payment method, which is not yet associated with a user. A front-end should call this endpoint directly, not a back-end. Requires a public developer key (use the AD-Public-Developer-Key header), which you must obtain from AppDirect.

info.name: List payment methods for a user

params.name: ownerId
params.description: ID of the user whose payment method you want to retrieve

params.name: companyId
params.description: ID of the company of which the user is a member

items.docs: Returns all available payment methods for the specified user in the specified company.

info.name: Create payment methods using a token OR by providing all of the payment method data

items.docs: When using a token, the validated payment method is assigned to the current user on the current marketplace. When providing all of the payment method data, the payment gateway is called, and the payment method is validated and assigned to the user.
The payment method is deleted from the system and cannot be used anymore.

params.name: ownerId
params.description: ID of the user whose default payment method you want to retrieve

params.name: companyId
params.description: ID of the company of which the user is a member

items.docs: Returns the default payment methods for the specified user in the specified company
Sets a default payment method for the specified user

info.name: Returns all supported Payment Method Types

items.docs: Returns all supported Payment Method Types. These are the only types of payment method that can be created.
